name: Supermemory
description: Supermemory lets agents save facts and preferences, and recall them later in other conversations and tools. Each user signs in to their own Supermemory account through the browser.

prompts.text: What do you remember about my preferences for code reviews?
Remember that the staging database moves to the new region next week.
What did we decide about the onboarding project last month?

apps.name: Supermemory
apps.description: Memory save and recall, over Supermemory's MCP server with browser sign-in.
